_comment: Cardholder preferences that the app uses as defaults on every device. Edit here (and push) to change the defaults everywhere; per-device overrides live in the browser's local storage. Valuations are cents per point (1.0 for cash back). Bilt Cash default 0.5: converting Bilt Cash to rent points costs $3 per 100 points, so at 1.5¢/point each $1 of Bilt Cash is worth ~$0.50; raise toward 1.0 if you reliably spend it dollar-for-dollar on Bilt credits (Lyft/Walgreens/Grubhub $10/mo, Bilt Travel hotels, dining, fitness).
